question: How should the inert body and limbs be regarded to support firmness?
premises: The body and limbs are an inert collection
They can be approached with thought suited to firmness
inference: Contemplation aligned with firmness reorients the inert body-aggregate
uncertainties: Referent of mad in maddārḍhya is context-dependent
plain_english: In the collection of the inert body and limbs, this occurs through contemplation suited to firmness.
